title: Six-material same-partition CoRichards qualification
question: On the exact frozen B1H six-material fixed-head transfer cohort, which conventional Richards discretisations using the L4, L6 and R8 Layer-ROM partitions remain numerically admissible under the frozen current-canonical Reference policy?

frozen_cohort.bottom_boundary: mode 5 zero pressure head at fixed 160-cm lower boundary
frozen_cohort.initial_state_rule: exact B1H frozen scaled-lambda construction; no new state selection

terminology.CoRichards: Conventional current-canonical Reference-Richards route executed on exactly the same fixed nonuniform partition and spatial state count as the corresponding Layer-ROM member.

numerical_policy.source_semantics: frozen B1H D13-derived mode-5 Reference route

controls.R16_exact_B1H_reproduction: For every material, the generalized B1HC harness on the 16x10-cm grid must reproduce the immutable B1H R16 scientific stdout byte-for-byte at O0 and O2.
controls.materialization: Recreate the frozen B1H material/history Fortran from pinned D13 source and current B0/B1H preregistration before generalizing geometry.
controls.source_freeze: No src/** or reference/** tree differences from current canonical.

per_material_history_status.QUALIFIED: O0 and O2 both finish the selected history with exactly 1024 committed states, hard transaction mass residual <=1e-12 cm, completion marker present, and byte-identical scientific stdout.
per_material_history_status.FAIL_CLOSED_REFERENCE_POLICY: O0 and O2 both fail under the frozen policy with the same first F_ROMV2_D13_REF_FAIL marker before completion.
per_material_history_status.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: Build, provenance, control identity, status identity, trace identity or harness failure not classifiable as frozen Reference policy.

qualification_outputs: status for every material x L4/L6/R8 x X01-X04 cell
qualified-history count per material and partition
full-common-cohort availability by partition across all 24 material-history cells
R16 exact B1H reproduction per material

decisions.B1HCQ_FULL_COMMON_COHORT_AVAILABLE: Hard gates pass and at least one of L4/L6/R8 qualifies all 24 frozen material-history cells.
decisions.B1HCQ_PARTIAL_COMMON_COHORT_ONLY: Hard gates pass, no partition qualifies all 24 cells, and at least one partition has one or more qualified cells.
decisions.B1HCQ_REDUCED_COMPARATOR_UNAVAILABLE: Hard gates pass and no L4/L6/R8 cell qualifies.
decisions.B1HCQ_COMPARATOR_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED: Any provenance, control or technical hard gate fails.

successor.if_full: Preregister componentwise LARE-versus-same-partition-CoRichards decomposition on the exact full common cohort; no runtime measurement in that decomposition.
successor.if_partial: Preregister the hydrological decomposition only on the exact persisted common qualified cells and report coverage loss; no extrapolation.
successor.if_unavailable: Do not relax numerical policy after result. Preserve comparator unavailability as evidence.
successor.if_blocked: Repair technical/provenance issues only before any scientific interpretation.
